source.text:
Location: Delhi, India

Remote: Yes, full overlap with UK/EU and US Eastern business hours; US Pacific mornings

Willing to relocate: Yes

Technologies: Python, TypeScript, Django, Next.js, Postgres, LLM agents, evals and tracing (Langfuse), real-time voice (LiveKit), Claude Code, Azure/AWS/GCP

Email: amanbir.s@gmail.com

Hands-on product and engineering leader with 14 years across engineering, ML and AI. Previously led product and engineering at Cuebo.ai and Monsoon CreditTech, building products from first prototype to enterprise customers.

Looking for a role where I can combine technical leadership, hands-on AI engineering and product direction.

Selected experience:

- Product and delivery: took three products from scratch to 15 lenders, with over 90% annual customer retention. Worked on what to build, what to cut, positioning and pitching.

- Production AI agents: built agents for sales, management consulting, law and finance, using offline evals, LLM-as-judge rubrics and production tracing to assess and improve reliability.

- Prototype to production: security and bug reviews, tests, CI, feature completion and production hardening. Most recently, worked on two internal AI platforms for a global media group.

- Real-time voice: built three voice agents on a self-hosted LiveKit fleet, serving 21 languages, with a focus on natural interactions and low latency.

- Agent-assisted development: set up coding agents and workflows from incoming requests to shipped changes, with monitoring agents to identify production problems.

- Regulated domains: built AI for tax, legal and medical work, using deterministic rules for decisions that require auditability and models for the surrounding tasks.
